Prerequisite(s): Beast shape class feature

Benefit: Your bestial nature manifests itself in one of the following ways, chosen when you take the feat and fixed thereafter: Night Senses (Ex) gains low-light or improved darkvision based on base race vision; Claws of the Beast (Ex) grows primary claws dealing 1d4 damage (1d3 Small), or improves existing claws by one damage step; Predator's Leap (Ex) allows a running jump without a running start; Wild Instinct (Ex) grants +2 on initiative and Survival checks.
